benefit: Dutch white clover understory fixes 50 to 100 lb N per acre annually, supports orchard pollinators, and forms a low-growing sward that tolerates orchard floor traffic. Keep a 24 inch herbicide-free strip at each trunk to prevent vole damage.

members.title: Clover frost-seed into alley
members.body: Frost-seed Dutch white clover into the orchard alley at 6 to 8 lb per acre in late winter. Mow 3 to 4 times per season to maintain a 4 to 6 inch height.
